title: ISA Architecture Comparison Matrix (Educational TIAN-ISA v1 vs. RISC & CISC Concepts)
summary: Contrasts TIAN-ISA v1 educational abstractions against general RISC and CISC architectural principles without claiming commercial silicon equivalence.

comparisonRows.generalRisc: Von Neumann unified DRAM + split L1i/L1d caches
comparisonRows.generalCisc: Von Neumann unified DRAM + split L1i/L1d caches
Decode to fixed micro-ops + Superscalar OoO engine

comparisonRows.tianIsa: 8 x 32-bit writable GPRs (R0-R7) + PC, IR, MAR, MDR, FLAGS
comparisonRows.generalRisc: Typically 32 GPRs (e.g., x0 hardwired zero in RISC-V)
comparisonRows.generalCisc: 8-16+ architectural GPRs backed by large rename files

scopeDisclaimer: TIAN-ISA v1 is an original educational ISA designed for visual datapath clarity; commercial RISC and CISC columns summarize general textbook traits rather than specific vendor parts.
